slides.headline: It isn't always the post. Sometimes it's one comment.
A huge thread can be mostly harmless.
That line can be the bit Google shows.
slides.body: Pulled into the search snippet, under your brand name.

slides.headline: It's what people screenshot and share.
slides.body: One comment can travel further than the post it sits in.

slides.headline: We handle comments as well as posts.
slides.body: Removing one comment is sometimes enough.

slides.headline: And you only pay if it's gone.
Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
